import Workflow.Spec
namespace Workflow
instance instDecidableValidRequest (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidRequest s r) := by
  unfold ValidRequest; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if _h : ValidRequest s r then
    (.ok, { docs := s.docs, users := s.users, status := fun d => expectedStatus s r d, content := fun d => expectedContent s r d, role := s.role, audit := expectedAudit s r })
  else
    (.rejected, s)

theorem req_authorization        : Authorized step := sorry
theorem req_single_doc           : SingleDoc step := sorry

theorem req_no_unpublish         : NoUnpublish step := sorry
theorem req_effects              : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_audit_append_only    : AuditAppendOnly step := sorry

end Workflow

lemma replay_append_lem : ∀ (l1 l2 : List Entry) (d : DocId) (st : Status), replay (l1 ++ l2) d st = replay l2 d (replay l1 d st) := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil => intro l2 d st; simp [replay]
  | cons e es ih => intro l2 d st; simp [replay, ih]

lemma replay_single_lem (e : Entry) (d : DocId) (st : Status) : replay [e] d st = (if e.doc = d then e.dst else st) := by
  simp [replay]

theorem req_audit_consistent : KeepsAuditConsistent step := by
  intro s r hcons d hd
  by_cases hval : ValidRequest s r
  · have hpair : (step s r).2 = ({ docs := s.docs, users := s.users, status := fun d => expectedStatus s r d, content := fun d => expectedContent s r d, role := s.role, audit := expectedAudit s r } : State) := by
      unfold step
      simp [dif_pos hval]
    rw [hpair]
    simp only
    show replay (expectedAudit s r) d .draft = expectedStatus s r d
    have hdmem : d ∈ s.docs := by simpa using hd
    have hreplay : replay s.audit d .draft = s.status d := hcons d hdmem
    unfold expectedAudit expectedStatus
    by_cases hk : r.kind = Kind.move
    · simp only [if_pos hk]
      have h1 : replay (s.audit ++ [⟨r.doc, r.actor, s.status r.doc, r.dst⟩]) d .draft = replay [⟨r.doc, r.actor, s.status r.doc, r.dst⟩] d (replay s.audit d .draft) := replay_append_lem _ _ _ _
      rw [h1, hreplay]
      simp only [replay_single_lem]
      by_cases heq : r.doc = d
      · have hcond : r.kind = Kind.move ∧ d = r.doc := ⟨hk, heq.symm⟩
        simp [hcond, heq]
      · have hcond : ¬ (r.kind = Kind.move ∧ d = r.doc) := by simp [hk, heq]
        simp only [hcond, ↓reduceIte]
        simp [heq]
    · simp only [if_neg hk]
      rw [hreplay]
      by_cases hcond : r.kind = Kind.move ∧ d = r.doc
      · exact absurd hcond.1 hk
      · rfl
  · have hpair : (step s r).2 = s := by
      unfold step
      simp [dif_neg hval]
    rw [hpair]
    exact hcons d (by simpa using hd)
